topic.title: False Breakouts: Read the Reaction, Not Just the Wick

research.summary: A false breakout can occur when price moves beyond a level and then returns back inside the area. Instead of reacting to one candle, study the close, follow-through, and what happens next. A single wick is information, not proof. Waiting for confirmation can reduce impulsive decisions, while still leaving room for the market to surprise you.
